title: The covering problem of Rado
exact_target: Among finite collections of axis-parallel squares covering area one, determine the smallest possible maximum area that can be retained by selecting pairwise disjoint squares.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7200025 (AMR-071-0025). CC BY 4.0.
